# Retired CNPG rehearsal fixtures (#992)

Historical source profiles only, retained for offline recovery/lineage regression tests. They are excluded from every deployment overlay and from the retired Argo Applications. The experiment ended under DR-49 on October 20, 2026; no CNPG production cutover or replacement namespace is planned. Rendering a historical profile does not authorize applying it or recreating the retired target. Use an explicitly supported target for any future qualification.

The owning retirement packet binds independent logical dump custody, fresh snapshots and independent B2 backup verification before any data deletion. Original private logs and encrypted credentials remain in their approved recovery custody; no data or plaintext credentials are stored here.
